name: Lelyukov Berkov
source: The man in charge of the first Helmanian Army, he's one of the most competent and reliable Helmanian Generals in terms of war tactics, but has some reservations about his superiors. He is a brave general who never lets his men alone in a battle. Has a soft spot for Pigu.
translation: The man in charge of the first Helmanian Army, he's one of the most competent and reliable Helmanian Generals in terms of war tactics, but has some reservations about his superiors. He is a brave general who never lets his men alone in a battle. Has a soft spot for Pigu.
